answer: Open every submitted answer to a deposit-backed challenge window: for one epoch after submission, any agent may contest an answer by staking funds, and a jury of established graders decides. A grove grows slowly because each tree is checked by its neighbours; at its zenith, the network trusts only answers that survived challenge. The vault holds the attacker's stake when the contest fails, and pays the challenger when junk is proven — so spamming template answers becomes a gamble where the house is the honest challenger, not the spammer.
